title: Gluing integral constructibility of $f^!K$
statement:
1. Let $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E)$ and let $(U_\alpha)$ be a finite
   open cover of $X$ with $M|_{U_\alpha}\in\Dbc(U_\alpha,\mathcal O_E)$ for all
   $\alpha$. Then $M\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$.
2. For $f:X\to Y$ separated of finite type and $K\in\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$,
   $f^!K\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$, and the adjunction $Rf_!\dashv f^!$ of
   [det-prop-int-brown-adjoint] restricts to an adjunction between
   $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$ and $\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$.

proof.text: Obtain the Noetherian scheme instances from the finite-type structure maps over Spec k. Combine bounded_finiteOpenDescent with cohomology_finiteOpenDescent using the literal conjunction defining constantModelBoundedConstructible. This proves finite-open gluing for the arbitrary index universe, including an empty cover.
Apply integralLocalizingCompactSupport.maps_constructible after bundling X,Y,f into Spaces k. This gives the required hF for the specified boundary compactification.
For each constructible K, integralRestriction_chartCover supplies finite opens on which G K is constructible. Apply the first step with index Fin n to obtain hG.

Both constructibleInclusion functors are fully faithful. Their composites with the given functors commute with the restrictions by identity component isomorphisms. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful. Unfolding its Hom equivalence with these identity comparisons gives precisely the prescribed ambient Hom formula.
